text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist cut its first quarter 1997 and year 1997 earnings and revenue estimates for General Scanning Inc "to reflect greater sluggishness in (General Scanning's) core laser system and thermal printer business."

-- In a statement, the investment firm said it reduced its first quarter earnings estimate to $0.14 a share on sales of $37.8 million from $0.18 a share on sales of $39.3 million. It lowered year 1997 earnings to $0.89 a share on sales of $169.1 million from $0.97 a share and $170.1 million, respectively.
-- It reiterated a buy rating and said its year 1997 cut in estimates could prove too conservative.
